comment: CANT-312. The one shared fixture set for image upload. The Go ingest test (cmd/catenary/mediafixtures_test.go), the TypeScript pre-check test and the Dart pre-check test all read this file and assert the same verdict, so a client's supported list or size cap that drifts from the server's fails a build. Nothing here is generated by the build; the oversize case is generated at test time from oversize and is never a committed file.
imageCapSource: DefaultMaxImageBytes in internal/config/config.go; the Go test fails if this number and that constant disagree
